content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    福伯以回公司接楚先生下班为理由，离开了楚梦瑶的别墅。
临走时，给了林逸一个背包，说是第一高中的校服以及课本。
“小姐，有事的话随时给我打电话，今天还是晚上七点钟来送晚饭。”
福伯说完，就匆匆离开了。
楚梦瑶看着眼前的男人，不知道该说什么，不过，总不能让他露宿街头吧？
自己的老爸可是出了名的慈善家，要是让人知道自己虐待下人，怎么都有点儿说不过去。
楚梦瑶气了半天，终于想到了这件事情的罪魁祸首，拿出手机，拨通了陈雨舒的号码：
“喂，小舒，我爸叫这个民工住在我的别墅里，我该怎么办呀？”
“瑶瑶姐，你说箭牌哥呀？那挺好呀，明天我就去学校说，你和他都同居了，这样就不会有人再缠着你了喔！”
陈雨舒此刻正舒服的躺在太妃床上看着电视，听了楚梦瑶的话，随口说道。
“陈雨舒！！！”
楚梦瑶要气炸了，对着电话吼道：“小妞你也太不仗义了吧？你叫我留下他的，现在又说风凉话是吧？你，立刻，马上，到我家来！”
“喔，好呀，一会儿我洗个澡，睡一觉，明早上学的时候就去找你。”
陈雨舒懒洋洋的说道。
“一分钟之内见不到你，就绝交！”
楚梦瑶斩钉截铁的说道。
“哎呀，人家都脱光光准备洗澡喔，还要穿衣服。”
陈雨舒抱怨着从沙发上坐起身来，对着镜子欣赏着自己的身材。
恩，似乎有了些小肚子呢？看来以后要少吃点儿东西了。
“五十秒！”

楚梦瑶看着手机上面的通话时间说道。
“喔……哎呀，总要锁门吧？”陈雨舒快速的穿好了衣服说道。
“四十秒！”
楚梦瑶继续说道。
“好了好了，我来了喔！”
陈雨舒穿上鞋子，跑出了门去。
陈雨舒的别墅距离楚梦瑶的别墅只有几十米而已，两座别墅中间隔了一条小路，斜对着遥遥相望。
远远的看到了陈雨舒的身影，楚梦瑶才松了口气，挂断了电话。
“瑶瑶姐，你做什么喔？人家刚将衣服脱掉，准备洗澡呢，你就叫我出来。”
陈雨舒埋怨的说道。
“咳咳！”
楚梦瑶咳嗽了两声，指了指林逸，然后道：“小舒，有外人在呢，说话注意些。”
“哎呀，没事儿喔。”
陈雨舒满不在乎的说道：“箭牌哥嘛，都是自己人！”
“既然你和他是自己人，那就叫他住你家好了！就这么愉快的决定了！”
楚梦瑶看着陈雨舒那幸灾乐祸的样子，很是不爽。
“呃……”
陈雨舒吐了吐舌头，无辜的一笑：“瑶瑶姐，你知道我的，回家就喜欢脱光光，让他住进来不太方便喔……”
“那住在我家就方便了？”
楚梦瑶心里大骂陈雨舒不仗义。

“哎，多简单的事儿喔？”
陈雨舒晃了晃小脑袋，然后说道：“瑶瑶姐你让她住你家，你来我家住，不就得了么？”
“恩，说的也是！”
楚梦瑶觉得，陈雨舒总算出了一个有点儿建设性的主意。
不过，楚梦瑶随即就有些不太乐意了，自己的别墅给一个民工去住？
凭什么呀？再说了，丢东西怎么办呀？
“不行！不能让他单独住在我的别墅里面！”
楚梦瑶咬牙说道。
陈雨舒也很为难，自己之前就是为了好玩儿，才叫楚梦瑶留下林逸的，但是现在的问题却来了，让林逸住进陈雨舒的别墅？
陈雨舒是绝对不会同意的。
犹豫了再三，陈雨舒终于想到了一个折中的办法：
“喔，要不，我陪着你一起住吧，叫他住在楼下好了，反正你的房间在楼上，我们不叫他上二楼就是了！”
楚梦瑶听了陈雨舒的建议，也觉得这是唯一的办法，只得不情愿的点了点头：
“好吧，那就这么办吧！”
陈雨舒经常和楚梦瑶住在一起，所以轻车熟路的进了去。
而林逸，则是拎着行李，慢吞吞的跟在后边。
楚梦瑶对他有敌意，林逸自然也能看出来，不过想到离家时老头子那郑重的嘱咐，和楚叔叔那信任的眼神，林逸对此也就没觉得有什么了。
毕竟楚梦瑶是个女孩子，不愿意和自己一起住那也是正常的。
“喂，你叫什么名字？”
楚梦瑶坐在沙发上，将自己修长的小腿扔在了太妃床上，看着林逸问道。

“我叫林……”
林逸边说话，边想坐在沙发上，在门口站了半天也够累了，可是屁股还没挨上沙发呢，就听到了一声娇斥，将林逸吓了一大跳。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. Uncle Fu left Chu Mengyao’s villa on the grounds of returning to the company to pick up Mr. Chu from get off work.
Before leaving, he gave Lin Yi a backpack, saying it was the uniform and textbooks of No. 1 High School.
"Miss, if you have anything, please call me at any time. I will deliver dinner at seven o'clock tonight."
After Fu Bo finished speaking, he left in a hurry.
Chu Mengyao looked at the man in front of her and didn't know what to say, but she couldn't let him sleep on the street, right?
His father is a well-known philanthropist. If people knew that he abused his servants, it would be a bit unjustifiable.
Chu Mengyao was angry for a long time, and finally thought of the culprit of this incident. She took out her mobile phone and dialed Chen Yushu's number:
"Hey, Xiao Shu, my dad asked this migrant worker to live in my villa, what should I do?"
"Sister Yaoyao, what are you talking about, Brother Wrigley? That's great. I'll go to the school tomorrow and tell him that you and he are living together, so no one will pester you anymore!"
Chen Yushu was lying comfortably on the concubine's bed and watching TV. After listening to Chu Mengyao's words, she said casually.
"Chen Yushu!!!"
Chu Mengyao was about to explode and yelled into the phone: "Girl, are you too unjust? You asked me to keep him, and now you are making sarcastic remarks, right? Come to my house right now!"
"Oh, okay, I'll take a shower and take a nap in a while, and then I'll find you when I go to school tomorrow morning."
Chen Yushu said lazily.
"If I don't see you within a minute, I'll break off the relationship!"
Chu Mengyao said decisively.
"Oh, everyone has stripped off to take a bath, and they still need to put on clothes."
Chen Yushu complained and sat up from the sofa, admiring her figure in the mirror.
Well, it seems like I have a little belly? It seems that I will eat less in the future.
"Fifty seconds!"
Chu Mengyao looked at the call time on the phone and said.
"Oh... Oops, you have to lock the door, right?" Chen Yushu quickly put on her clothes and said.
"Forty seconds!"
Chu Mengyao continued.
"Okay, okay, here I come!"
Chen Yushu put on her shoes and ran out the door.
Chen Yushu's villa is only a few dozen meters away from Chu Mengyao's villa. There is a small road between the two villas, facing each other diagonally.
Seeing Chen Yushu's figure from a distance, Chu Mengyao breathed a sigh of relief and hung up the phone.
"Sister Yaoyao, what are you doing? I just took off my clothes and was about to take a bath, so you asked me to come out."
Chen Yushu said complainingly.
"Ahem!"
Chu Mengyao coughed twice, pointed at Lin Yi, and then said: "Xiao Shu, there are outsiders here, please be careful what you say."
"Oh, it's okay."
Chen Yushu said nonchalantly: "Brother Wrigley, we are all our own!"
"Since you and him are the same, let him live in your house! It's such a happy decision!"
Chu Mengyao was very unhappy looking at Chen Yushu's gloating look.
"Uh..."
Chen Yushu stuck out her tongue and smiled innocently: "Sister Yaoyao, you know that I like to take off my clothes when I get home. It's not convenient for him to live in..."
"Is it convenient to live in my house?"
Chu Mengyao cursed Chen Yushu in her heart for being unjust.
"Hey, how simple is that?"
Chen Yushu shook her little head, and then said: "Sister Yaoyao, let her live in your home, and you come to live in mine, isn't it okay?"
"Well, that's right!"
Chu Mengyao felt that Chen Yushu finally came up with a somewhat constructive idea.
However, Chu Mengyao immediately became a little unhappy. Would she let a migrant worker live in her villa?
Why? Besides, what should I do if I lose something?
"No! We can't let him live alone in my villa!"
Chu Mengyao gritted her teeth and said.
Chen Yushu was also in a dilemma. She did it just for fun.Chu Mengyao was asked to keep Lin Yi, but now the question arises, let Lin Yi live in Chen Yushu's villa?
Chen Yushu would never agree.
After much hesitation, Chen Yushu finally thought of a compromise:
"Oh, how about I live with you and ask him to live downstairs? Since your room is upstairs anyway, we just don't want him to go up to the second floor!"
After hearing Chen Yushu's suggestion, Chu Mengyao felt that this was the only way, so she nodded reluctantly:
"Okay, let's do it!"
Chen Yushu often lived with Chu Mengyao, so he went in easily.
Lin Yi, on the other hand, carried his luggage and followed slowly.
Lin Yi could naturally tell that Chu Mengyao was hostile to him, but thinking of the old man's solemn instructions when leaving home and Uncle Chu's trusting eyes, Lin Yi didn't think anything of it.
After all, Chu Mengyao is a girl, so it's normal that she doesn't want to live with him.
"Hey, what's your name?"
Chu Mengyao sat on the sofa, threw her slender calves on the toffee bed, looked at Lin Yi and asked.
"My name is Lin..."
While Lin Yi was talking, he wanted to sit on the sofa. He was tired from standing at the door for a long time, but before his butt touched the sofa, he heard a scolding sound, which startled Lin Yi.
